data.text:
Afzal Khan vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 24 June, 2024 
Author: Jayant Banerji
Bench: Jayant Banerji
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:104854-Db
Court No. - 64
Case :- Writ - C No. - 20405 of 2024
Petitioner :- Afzal Khan
Respondent :- State Of Up And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Asar Mukhtar,Ikram Ahmad 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Jayant Banerji,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.  Learned counsel for the petitioner, at the outset, fairly states that against the order impugned,
there is an appeal provided under Section 32 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and, as such, he may be permitted with withdraw this petition to enable him to pursue his remedy. 
2. This petition is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn. 
Order Date :- 24.6.2024 SK (Manjive Shukla, J.) (Jayant Banerji, J.)
